_comment: Immutability ledger for applied migrations (testing contract, static gate 2).
A migration that has run against any deployed database is history: editing it
leaves every database that already applied the old text silently divergent from
the file that claims to describe it, and drizzle's journal records only that the
tag ran, never what it said. This file is the missing half.
tests/migrations/static-gates.test.ts hashes every drizzle/*.sql and compares.
Adding a migration adds a line here. Changing one CHANGES a line here, which is
the visible, reviewable diff that says an applied migration was rewritten - the
thing that would otherwise pass review as an ordinary SQL edit.
